user.title: Connect to Polkka Aromi Menu
user.description: On your daycare's Polkka menu page, open the browser dev tools Network tab, reload, and find the POST request to a URL ending in '/RestaurantMeals'. Paste that URL (without the '?Id=...' query string) below, along with the 'Id' query parameter value and the full JSON request body.
